<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Alpona Crafts | Hand-Painted Punjabi Collection</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --maroon:#5E1A22;
    --maroon-dark:#3E0F15;
    --terracotta:#B85C2E;
    --gold:#B4903F;
    --ivory:#FAF3E7;
    --ivory-deep:#F2E6D3;
    --ink:#2A1B14;
    --ink-soft:#5B4A3E;
    --line:#E3D3B8;
    --white-tag:#8C8C8C;
    --red-tag:#A3273A;
    --blue-tag:#2B5C8A;
    --green-tag:#3B6B45;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(62,15,21,0.12);
    --radius: 4px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    font-family:'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif;
    background:var(--ivory);
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.5;
    padding-bottom:70px;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:0.01em;
  }
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  button{font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:none;}

  /* ---------- Alpona dot-line motif divider ---------- */
  .alpona-rule{
    height:14px;
    width:100%;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle, var(--gold) 1.6px, transparent 1.7px);
    background-size: 18px 14px;
    background-position: center;
    opacity:0.55;
  }

  /* ---------- Top info bar ---------- */
  .topbar{
    background:var(--maroon-dark);
    color:var(--ivory-deep);
    font-size:0.82rem;
    padding:7px 16px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:18px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .topbar a{opacity:0.92;}
  .topbar a:hover{opacity:1; text-decoration:underline;}

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header{
    background:var(--ivory);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:18px 20px 14px;
  }
  .header-inner{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:16px;
    justify-content:space-between;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .brand{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:14px;
  }
  .brand img{
    width:64px;
    height:64px;
    border-radius:50%;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .brand-text h1{
    font-size:1.7rem;
    color:var(--maroon);
    line-height:1.1;
  }
  .brand-text p{
    font-size:0.85rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-style:italic;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .header-actions{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .search-box{
    position:relative;
  }
  .search-box input{
    padding:9px 14px 9px 34px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:20px;
    background:#fff;
    font-size:0.9rem;
    width:200px;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .search-box input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:1px;}
  .search-box svg{
    position:absolute;
    left:11px;
    top:50%;
    transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:15px;
    height:15px;
    stroke:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .cart-btn{
    position:relative;
    background:var(--maroon);
    color:#fff;
    padding:10px 16px;
    border-radius:24px;
    font-size:0.9rem;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
    transition:background 0.2s;
  }
  .cart-btn:hover{background:var(--maroon-dark);}
  .cart-count{
    background:var(--gold);
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.75rem;
    min-width:19px;
    height:19px;
    border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:0 3px;
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:28px auto 8px;
    padding:0 20px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr;
    gap:32px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .hero-copy .eyebrow-motif{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:10px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .eyebrow-motif span{
    width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);
  }
  .eyebrow-motif p{
    font-size:0.82rem;
    color:var(--terracotta);
    letter-spacing:0.03em;
  }
  .hero-copy h2{
    font-size:2.6rem;
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
    line-height:1.12;
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .hero-copy p.lead{
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    font-size:1.02rem;
    max-width:480px;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .hero-cta{
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:var(--maroon);
    color:#fff;
    padding:13px 26px;
    border-radius:26px;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--maroon-dark); transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-outline{
    border:1.5px solid var(--maroon);
    color:var(--maroon);
    padding:11.5px 24px;
    border-radius:26px;
    font-size:0.95rem;
    font-weight:600;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover{background:var(--maroon); color:#fff;}
  .hero-visual{
    position:relative;
    aspect-ratio:1/1;
    border-radius:50%;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    border:6px solid #fff;
    outline:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .hero-visual img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;}

  /* ---------- Category & filters ---------- */
  .filter-bar{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:34px auto 6px;
    padding:0 20px;
    display:flex;
    gap:10px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .filter-chip{
    background:#fff;
    border:1.5px solid var(--line);
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding:8px 18px;
    border-radius:20px;
    font-size:0.88rem;
    font-weight:500;
    transition:all 0.15s;
  }
  .filter-chip.active, .filter-chip:hover{
    background:var(--maroon);
    border-color:var(--maroon);
    color:#fff;
  }

  /* ---------- Product grid ---------- */
  .section-title{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:6px auto 0;
    padding:0 20px;
  }
  .section-title h3{
    font-size:1.7rem;
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
  }
  .product-grid{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:18px auto 40px;
    padding:0 20px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap:22px;
  }
  .product-card{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:var(--radius);
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    transition:box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  }
  .product-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow); transform:translateY(-3px);}
  .product-img-wrap{
    position:relative;
    aspect-ratio:3/4;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--ivory-deep);
  }
  .product-img-wrap img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover;}
  .tag{
    position:absolute;
    top:10px;
    left:10px;
    font-size:0.7rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:#fff;
    padding:3px 10px;
    border-radius:12px;
    text-transform:capitalize;
  }
  .product-info{
    padding:14px 16px 16px;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    gap:6px;
    flex:1;
  }
  .product-info h4{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.25;
  }
  .product-info .desc{
    font-size:0.82rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    flex:1;
  }
  .product-info .price-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    margin-top:8px;
  }
  .price{
    font-size:1.15rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--maroon);
  }
  .add-btn{
    background:var(--ivory-deep);
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    padding:8px 15px;
    border-radius:20px;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-weight:600;
    transition:all 0.15s;
  }
  .add-btn:hover{background:var(--maroon); color:#fff; border-color:var(--maroon);}
  .add-btn.added{background:var(--maroon); color:#fff;}
  .no-results{
    grid-column:1/-1;
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding:50px 0;
    font-size:1rem;
  }

  /* ---------- Trust strip ---------- */
  .trust-strip{
    background:var(--ivory-deep);
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:26px 20px;
  }
  .trust-inner{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
    gap:20px;
    text-align:center;
  }
  .trust-inner div h5{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
    margin-bottom:3px;
  }
  .trust-inner div p{font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--ink-soft);}

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer{
    background:var(--maroon-dark);
    color:var(--ivory-deep);
    padding:36px 20px 20px;
  }
  .footer-inner{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap:28px;
  }
  .footer-inner h4{
    font-family:'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size:1.2rem;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    color:#fff;
  }
  .footer-inner p, .footer-inner a{
    font-size:0.85rem;
    opacity:0.85;
    display:block;
    margin-bottom:7px;
  }
  .footer-inner a:hover{opacity:1; text-decoration:underline;}
  .footer-bottom{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:26px auto 0;
    padding-top:16px;
    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    font-size:0.78rem;
    text-align:center;
    opacity:0.7;
  }

  /* ---------- Cart drawer ---------- */
  .overlay{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    background:rgba(42,27,20,0.5);
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 0.25s;
    z-index:90;
  }
  .overlay.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto;}
  .cart-drawer{
    position:fixed;
    top:0; right:-420px;
    width:100%; max-width:420px;
    height:100%;
    background:var(--ivory);
    box-shadow:-6px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    z-index:100;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    transition:right 0.3s ease;
  }
  .cart-drawer.open{right:0;}
  .cart-header{
    padding:18px 20px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    background:#fff;
  }
  .cart-header h3{font-size:1.4rem; color:var(--maroon-dark);}
  .close-btn{
    background:none;
    font-size:1.4rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    line-height:1;
    padding:4px;
  }
  .cart-items{
    flex:1;
    overflow-y:auto;
    padding:14px 20px;
  }
  .cart-empty{
    text-align:center;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    padding:60px 10px;
    font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .cart-item{
    display:flex;
    gap:12px;
    padding:12px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .cart-item img{
    width:64px; height:78px;
    object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:3px;
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .cart-item-info{flex:1; min-width:0;}
  .cart-item-info h5{
    font-size:0.92rem;
    font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom:2px;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .cart-item-info .unit-price{
    font-size:0.8rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    margin-bottom:6px;
  }
  .qty-row{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;}
  .qty-btn{
    width:24px; height:24px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:50%;
    font-size:0.9rem;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    color:var(--maroon);
  }
  .qty-btn:hover{background:var(--ivory-deep);}
  .qty-val{font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; min-width:16px; text-align:center;}
  .remove-btn{
    background:none;
    color:var(--red-tag);
    font-size:0.78rem;
    margin-left:auto;
    text-decoration:underline;
  }
  .item-subtotal{
    font-size:0.92rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--maroon);

  .cart-footer{

    padding:16px 20px 20px;

  }
  .total-row{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    font-size:1.15rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:var(--maroon-dark);
    margin-bottom:14px;

  .checkout-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--maroon);
    color:#fff;
    padding:13px;
    border-radius:26px;
    font-size:0.98rem;
    font-weight:600;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .checkout-btn:hover{background:var(--maroon-dark);}
  .whatsapp-order-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:#25D366;
    color:#fff;
    padding:13px;
    border-radius:26px;
    font-size:0.98rem;
    font-weight:600;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .whatsapp-order-btn:hover{background:#1fb958;}

  /* ---------- Checkout modal ---------- */
  .modal{
    position:fixed; inset:0;
    z-index:110;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    padding:20px;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity 0.25s;
  }
  .modal.show{opacity:1; pointer-events:auto;}
  .modal-box{
    background:var(--ivory);
    max-width:480px;
    width:100%;
    max-height:90vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:26px 26px 22px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    position:relative;
  }
  .modal-box h3{font-size:1.5rem; color:var(--maroon-dark); margin-bottom:4px;}
  .modal-box .sub{font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:18px;}
  .form-group{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .form-group label{
    display:block;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--ink);
    margin-bottom:5px;
  }
  .form-group input, .form-group textarea{
    width:100%;

    border-radius:4px;
    background:#fff;
    font-size:0.92rem;

    color:var(--ink);

  .form-group input:focus, .form-group textarea:focus{

  }
  .form-group textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:64px;}
  .order-summary-box{
    background:#fff;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    margin-bottom:16px;
    font-size:0.85rem;
    max-height:130px;
    overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .order-summary-box .os-row{

    justify-content:space-between;

    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .order-summary-box .os-total{

  .submit-order-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:var(--maroon);
    color:#fff;
    padding:13px;
    border-radius:26px;
    font-size:0.98rem;

  .modal-close{

    top:14px; right:16px;

    font-size:1.4rem;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .confirm-screen{text-align:center; padding:20px 4px;}
  .confirm-screen .tick{
    width:56px; height:56px;
    border-radius:50%;

  }
  .confirm-screen h3{margin-bottom:8px;}
  .confirm-screen p{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:18px;}
  .form-error{

  /* ---------- Floating WhatsApp widget ---------- */
  .wa-float{
    position:fixed;
    bottom:22px; right:22px;
    width:56px; height:56px;

    transition:transform 0.2s;

  .wa-float:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
  .wa-float svg{width:28px; height:28px; fill:#fff;}

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width:980px){
    .product-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}
    .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero-visual{max-width:280px; margin:0 auto; order:-1;}
    .footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  }
  @media (max-width:640px){
    .product-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .search-box input{width:130px;}
    .hero-copy h2{font-size:2rem;}
    .trust-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .footer-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .cart-drawer{max-width:100%;}
    .wa-float{bottom:16px; right:16px; width:52px; height:52px;}

  <h3>Hand-Painted Punjabi Collection</h3>
</div>

<div class="trust-strip">

  </div>
</div>

    </div>
    <div>
      <h4>Contact</h4>
      <a href="tel:+918167714798">+91 81677 14798</a>
      <a href="mailto:alpona.crafts.1@gmail.com">alpona.crafts.1@gmail.com</a>

<!-- Floating WhatsApp -->
<a class="wa-float" href="https://wa.me/918167714798?text=Namaskar%2C%20I%27m%20interested%20in%20Alpona%20Crafts%20punjabis." target="_blank" aria-label="Chat on WhatsApp">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32"><path d="M16.001 3C9.373 3 4 8.373 4 15c0 2.386.703 4.605 1.912 6.47L4 29l7.72-1.865A11.94 11.94 0 0016 27c6.628 0 12-5.373 12-12S22.629 3 16.001 3zm6.995 16.995c-.29.816-1.44 1.523-2.35 1.72-.62.13-1.43.235-4.16-.895-3.49-1.44-5.73-4.955-5.905-5.19-.17-.235-1.42-1.89-1.42-3.605 0-1.715.9-2.555 1.22-2.905.32-.35.7-.44.935-.44.235 0 .47.002.675.012.216.01.507-.082.793.605.29.7.985 2.42 1.07 2.596.087.176.145.383.03.618-.117.235-.176.383-.35.588-.176.206-.37.46-.53.617-.176.176-.36.367-.155.72.206.352.917 1.513 1.968 2.45 1.353 1.207 2.494 1.582 2.846 1.76.352.176.558.147.764-.088.206-.235.882-1.03 1.117-1.383.235-.353.47-.294.793-.176.323.117 2.047.966 2.4 1.142.352.176.587.264.674.41.088.147.088.848-.202 1.664z"/></svg>
</a>

<!-- Cart drawer -->
<div class="overlay" id="overlay"></div>
<div class="cart-drawer" id="cartDrawer">
  <div class="cart-header">
    <h3>Your Cart</h3>
    <button class="close-btn" id="closeCartBtn">&times;</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cart-items" id="cartItems"></div>
  <div class="cart-footer">
    <div class="total-row"><span>Grand Total</span><span id="cartTotal">₹0</span></div>
    <button class="checkout-btn" id="openCheckoutBtn">Place Order (Email)</button>
    <button class="whatsapp-order-btn" id="whatsappOrderBtn">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" width="18" height="18" fill="#fff"><path d="M16.001 3C9.373 3 4 8.373 4 15c0 2.386.703 4.605 1.912 6.47L4 29l7.72-1.865A11.94 11.94 0 0016 27c6.628 0 12-5.373 12-12S22.629 3 16.001 3zm6.995 16.995c-.29.816-1.44 1.523-2.35 1.72-.62.13-1.43.235-4.16-.895-3.49-1.44-5.73-4.955-5.905-5.19-.17-.235-1.42-1.89-1.42-3.605 0-1.715.9-2.555 1.22-2.905.32-.35.7-.44.935-.44.235 0 .47.002.675.012.216.01.507-.082.793.605.29.7.985 2.42 1.07 2.596.087.176.145.383.03.618-.117.235-.176.383-.35.588-.176.206-.37.46-.53.617-.176.176-.36.367-.155.72.206.352.917 1.513 1.968 2.45 1.353 1.207 2.494 1.582 2.846 1.76.352.176.558.147.764-.088.206-.235.882-1.03 1.117-1.383.235-.353.47-.294.793-.176.323.117 2.047.966 2.4 1.142.352.176.587.264.674.41.088.147.088.848-.202 1.664z"/></svg>
      Order via WhatsApp
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Checkout modal -->
<div class="modal" id="checkoutModal">
  <div class="modal-box" id="checkoutBox">
    <button class="modal-close" id="closeModalBtn">&times;</button>
    <div id="checkoutFormWrap">
      <h3>Complete Your Order</h3>
      <p class="sub">Fill in your details below — we'll receive your order by email and reach out on WhatsApp.</p>
      <div id="formErrorBox"></div>
      <div class="order-summary-box" id="modalOrderSummary"></div>
      <form id="orderForm">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="custName">Full Name *</label>
          <input type="text" id="custName" name="Customer_Name" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="custPhone">Phone Number *</label>
          <input type="tel" id="custPhone" name="Phone_Number" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="custAddress">Delivery Address *</label>
          <textarea id="custAddress" name="Delivery_Address" required></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="custNote">Special Instructions (optional)</label>
          <textarea id="custNote" name="Special_Instructions"></textarea>
        </div>
        <input type="hidden" name="Order_Details" id="orderDetailsField">
        <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="🧵 New Order Received – Alpona Crafts">
        <button type="submit" class="submit-order-btn" id="submitOrderBtn">Confirm &amp; Send Order</button>
      </form>
    </div>
    <div class="confirm-screen" id="confirmScreen" style="display:none;">
      <div class="tick">✓</div>
      <h3>Order Sent Successfully!</h3>
      <p>Alpona Crafts will reach out to you on WhatsApp shortly to confirm your order.</p>
      <a href="https://wa.me/918167714798" target="_blank" class="btn-primary" style="display:inline-block;">Message us on WhatsApp</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   ALPONA CRAFTS — PRODUCT CATALOG
   ========================================================= */
const PRODUCTS = [
  { id:'p1', name:'White Hand-Painted Punjabi (Design 1)', price:2299, category:'white',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/YTTxkfz1/IMG-20260925-222338.png', desc:'Pure cotton hand-painted white designer Punjabi' },
  { id:'p2', name:'White Hand-Painted Punjabi (Design 2)', price:2399, category:'white',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/s9FMsYrq/IMG-20260925-222313.png', desc:'Elegant white Punjabi with floral brushstroke art' },
  { id:'p3', name:'White Hand-Painted Punjabi (Design 3)', price:2499, category:'white',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/Z6s8B3pW/IMG-20260925-222258.png', desc:'Exclusive handcrafted white silk-cotton Punjabi' },
  { id:'p4', name:'Red Hand-Painted Punjabi (Design 1)', price:2299, category:'red',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/S4HN4g60/IMG-20260925-222326.png', desc:'Vibrant red Punjabi with traditional Bengali artwork' },
  { id:'p5', name:'Red Hand-Painted Punjabi (Design 2)', price:2399, category:'red',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/m5BhWvxm/IMG-20260925-222232.png', desc:'Royal crimson hand-painted festive Punjabi' },
  { id:'p6', name:'Red-White Combo Hand-Painted Punjabi', price:2599, category:'red',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/CpQ3Xr4s/IMG-20260925-222210.png', desc:'Classic Red & White combination handcrafted Punjabi' },
  { id:'p7', name:'Blue Hand-Painted Punjabi', price:2399, category:'blue',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/wFzFt0tN/IMG-20260926-214451.png', desc:'Royal blue Punjabi featuring artistic motifs' },
  { id:'p8', name:'Green Hand-Painted Punjabi', price:2499, category:'green',
    img:'https://i.ibb.co/5WbwwrBK/IMG-20260926-214300.png', desc:'Deep emerald green hand-painted premium Punjabi' },
];

const TAG_COLORS = { white:'#8C8C8C', red:'#A3273A', blue:'#2B5C8A', green:'#3B6B45' };
const SHOP_PHONE = '918167714798';
const FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT = 'https://formspree.io/f/mnpngwnk';

/* =========================================================
   STATE
   ========================================================= */
let cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('alponaCart') || '{}');
let activeCategory = 'all';
let searchTerm = '';

function saveCart(){ localStorage.setItem('alponaCart', JSON.stringify(cart)); }
function money(n){ return '₹' + n.toLocaleString('en-IN'); }

/* =========================================================
   RENDER PRODUCT GRID
   ========================================================= */
function renderProducts(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
  const filtered = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>{
    const matchCat = activeCategory === 'all' || p.category === activeCategory;
    const matchSearch = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    return matchCat && matchSearch;
  });

  if(filtered.length === 0){
    grid.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">No products found. Try a different category or search.</div>';
    return;
  }

  grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(p => `
    <div class="product-card">
      <div class="product-img-wrap">
        <span class="tag" style="background:${TAG_COLORS[p.category]}">${p.category}</span>
        <img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy">
      </div>
      <div class="product-info">
        <h4>${p.name}</h4>
        <p class="desc">${p.desc}</p>
        <div class="price-row">
          <span class="price">${money(p.price)}</span>
          <button class="add-btn" data-id="${p.id}">Add to Cart</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  grid.querySelectorAll('.add-btn').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      addToCart(btn.dataset.id);
      btn.textContent = 'Added ✓';
      btn.classList.add('added');
      setTimeout(()=>{ btn.textContent='Add to Cart'; btn.classList.remove('added'); }, 1200);
    });
  });
}

/* =========================================================
   CART LOGIC
   ========================================================= */
function addToCart(id){
  cart[id] = (cart[id] || 0) + 1;
  saveCart();
  renderCart();
}
function changeQty(id, delta){
  if(!cart[id]) return;
  cart[id] += delta;
  if(cart[id] <= 0) delete cart[id];
  saveCart();
  renderCart();
}
function removeFromCart(id){
  delete cart[id];
  saveCart();
  renderCart();
}
function getCartLines(){
  return Object.keys(cart).map(id=>{
    const product = PRODUCTS.find(p=>p.id===id);
    if(!product) return null;
    return { product, qty:cart[id], subtotal: product.price * cart[id] };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}
function getCartTotal(){
  return getCartLines().reduce((sum,l)=>sum+l.subtotal, 0);
}
function getCartCount(){
  return Object.values(cart).reduce((a,b)=>a+b, 0);
}

function renderCart(){
  const lines = getCartLines();
  document.getElementById('cartCount').textContent = getCartCount();
  document.getElementById('cartTotal').textContent = money(getCartTotal());

  const itemsBox = document.getElementById('cartItems');
  if(lines.length === 0){
    itemsBox.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty">Your cart is empty<br>Add some beautiful punjabis!</div>';
    return;
  }
  itemsBox.innerHTML = lines.map(l => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <img src="${l.product.img}" alt="${l.product.name}">
      <div class="cart-item-info">
        <h5>${l.product.name}</h5>
        <div class="unit-price">${money(l.product.price)} each</div>
        <div class="qty-row">
          <button class="qty-btn" data-act="dec" data-id="${l.product.id}">−</button>
          <span class="qty-val">${l.qty}</span>
          <button class="qty-btn" data-act="inc" data-id="${l.product.id}">+</button>
          <button class="remove-btn" data-act="remove" data-id="${l.product.id}">Remove</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="item-subtotal">${money(l.subtotal)}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');

  itemsBox.querySelectorAll('[data-act]').forEach(btn=>{
    const id = btn.dataset.id;
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(btn.dataset.act === 'inc') changeQty(id, 1);
      else if(btn.dataset.act === 'dec') changeQty(id, -1);
      else if(btn.dataset.act === 'remove') removeFromCart(id);
    });
  });
}

/* =========================================================
   ORDER SUMMARY TEXT (used by WhatsApp order message)
   ========================================================= */
function buildOrderSummaryText(){
  const lines = getCartLines();
  let text = 'ORDER SUMMARY — Alpona Crafts\n';
  text += '--------------------------------\n';
  lines.forEach(l=>{
    text += `${l.product.name}\n  Qty: ${l.qty}  x  ${money(l.product.price)}  =  ${money(l.subtotal)}\n`;
  });
  text += '--------------------------------\n';
  text += `GRAND TOTAL: ${money(getCartTotal())}\n`;
  return text;
}

/* =========================================================
   CART DRAWER OPEN/CLOSE
   ========================================================= */
const cartDrawer = document.getElementById('cartDrawer');
const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
function openCart(){ cartDrawer.classList.add('open'); overlay.classList.add('show'); }
function closeCart(){ cartDrawer.classList.remove('open'); overlay.classList.remove('show'); }
document.getElementById('openCartBtn').addEventListener('click', openCart);
document.getElementById('closeCartBtn').addEventListener('click', closeCart);
overlay.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ closeCart(); closeModal(); });

/* =========================================================
   FILTERS + SEARCH
   ========================================================= */
document.getElementById('filterBar').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  const chip = e.target.closest('.filter-chip');
  if(!chip) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(c=>c.classList.remove('active'));
  chip.classList.add('active');
  activeCategory = chip.dataset.cat;
  renderProducts();
});
document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e)=>{
  searchTerm = e.target.value;
  renderProducts();
});

/* =========================================================
   WHATSAPP ORDER
   ========================================================= */
document.getElementById('whatsappOrderBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(getCartCount() === 0){ alert('Your cart is empty. Please add products first.'); return; }
  const msg = `Namaskar Alpona Crafts! I would like to place an order:\n\n${buildOrderSummaryText()}\nPlease get in touch with me. Thank you.`;
  const url = `https://wa.me/${SHOP_PHONE}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
  window.open(url, '_blank');
});

/* =========================================================
   CHECKOUT MODAL (Formspree email order)
   ========================================================= */
const checkoutModal = document.getElementById('checkoutModal');
function openModal(){
  if(getCartCount() === 0){ alert('Your cart is empty. Please add products first.'); return; }
  document.getElementById('modalOrderSummary').innerHTML =
    getCartLines().map(l=>`<div class="os-row"><span>${l.product.name} × ${l.qty}</span><span>${money(l.subtotal)}</span></div>`).join('') +
    `<div class="os-row os-total"><span>Grand Total</span><span>${money(getCartTotal())}</span></div>`;
  checkoutModal.classList.add('show');
  overlay.classList.add('show');
}
function closeModal(){
  checkoutModal.classList.remove('show');
  overlay.classList.remove('show');
}
document.getElementById('openCheckoutBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  closeCart();
  document.getElementById('checkoutFormWrap').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('confirmScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('orderForm').reset();
  openModal();
});
document.getElementById('closeModalBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

document.getElementById('orderForm').addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const errorBox = document.getElementById('formErrorBox');
  errorBox.innerHTML = '';

  if(FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT.includes('YOUR_FORM_ID')){
    errorBox.innerHTML = '<div class="form-error">⚠️ Formspree form ID has not been set up yet. Please ask the shop owner to add their form ID from formspree.io — see setup instructions.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const name = document.getElementById('custName').value.trim();
  const phone = document.getElementById('custPhone').value.trim();
  const address = document.getElementById('custAddress').value.trim();
  const note = document.getElementById('custNote').value.trim();

  const fullSummary =
    `Customer Name: ${name}\n` +
    `Phone: ${phone}\n` +
    `Delivery Address: ${address}\n` +
    `Special Instructions: ${note || '—'}\n\n` +
    buildOrderSummaryText();

  document.getElementById('orderDetailsField').value = fullSummary;

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitOrderBtn');
  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  submitBtn.textContent = 'Sending...';

  try{
    const formData = new FormData(document.getElementById('orderForm'));
    const res = await fetch(FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT, {
      method:'POST',
      body: formData,
      headers:{ 'Accept':'application/json' }
    });
    if(res.ok){
      document.getElementById('checkoutFormWrap').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('confirmScreen').style.display = 'block';
      cart = {};
      saveCart();
      renderCart();
    } else {
      throw new Error('Submission failed');
    }
  } catch(err){
    errorBox.innerHTML = '<div class="form-error">There was a problem sending your order. Please try again or order via WhatsApp instead.</div>';
  } finally{
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.textContent = 'Confirm & Send Order';
  }
});

/* =========================================================
   INIT
   ========================================================= */
renderProducts();
renderCart();
</script>
</body>
</html>
